monitored_text: Home Newsroom 2025 May Day Holiday Schedule 2025 May Day Holiday Schedule Press Release Apr 23, 2025 JLC factories will have a 3-day holiday from May 1 to 3, 2025 . During this time, orders can still be placed and customer service will remain available. Note: CNC Machining Orders placed after 6 pm, April 30th GMT+8 will start to produce on May 4th. No impact on the In-stock Parts Service; in-stock parts are added to your library immediately after checkout. The delivery date will be postponed accordingly. JLC Holiday Schedule Logistics companies Schedule If you have any questions about the above information or need order support, please contact our customer service team support@jlcpcb.com .
